evidence: Clients on the 10.20.30.0/24 LAN receive no usable lease.
R17 show ip dhcp pool output indicates pool LAB uses network 10.20.0.0 255.255.0.0.
R17 show ip interface brief output indicates interface Gi0/0 has address 10.20.30.1 with a /24 subnet implicitly or directly related to the interface state up/up.
root_cause: The DHCP pool LAB is configured with network 10.20.0.0 255.255.0.0 (/16), which does not match the client LAN subnet 10.20.30.0/24 on the Gi0/0 interface (10.20.30.1/24).
verification: Run show ip dhcp pool to confirm the network statement matches 10.20.30.0 255.255.255.0.
Manually verify that a client on the 10.20.30.0/24 LAN successfully receives a usable IP lease after the approved change.
fix_steps: Verify the current DHCP pool configuration using show running-config or show ip dhcp pool.
Remove the incorrect network statement from the DHCP pool LAB.
Configure the correct DHCP pool network statement to match the client subnet 10.20.30.0/24 with mask 255.255.255.0.
Verify the updated DHCP pool configuration.
Test lease acquisition from a client on the 10.20.30.0/24 LAN.

rule_checker_findings.evidence: DHCP pool LAB network (10.20.0.0/16) does not match client LAN interface (10.20.30.1/24).
rule_checker_findings.recommended_action: Reconfigure DHCP pool network statement to match client subnet 10.20.30.0/24.
